verified_facts.text: The resort has a 500,000-gallon saltwater lagoon where guests can snorkel alongside marine life.
verified_facts.excerpt: snorkeling alongside wonderful wildlife in a 500,000-gallon saltwater lagoon

verified_facts.text: The Under the Sea Lagoon experiences are led by expert marine aquarists who share insights about the local ecosystem.
verified_facts.excerpt: Led by expert marine aquarists, our Under the Sea Lagoon Experiences place you face-to-face with graceful rays

verified_facts.text: Guests aged 8 and older can join the lagoon snorkel experience, while children under 8 can take part in the stingray portion.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests 8 and older can join the snorkel experience, with children under 8 participating in the stingray portion.

verified_facts.text: The resort has resident Aldabra giant tortoises that guests can meet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Back on dry land, meet our resident Aldabra tortoises, gentle giants who are one of the world’s largest species of tortoise

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Longboat Key is an 18-acre coastal resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: a newly-opened, 18-acre coastal resort offering a premier beachside experience

verified_facts.text: The St. Regis Spa is a 20,000-square-foot spa centered around the healing power of water, with indoor and outdoor vitality waters and an oceanfront relaxation room.
verified_facts.excerpt: our 20,000 square-foot spa features indoor and outdoor vitality waters, an oceanfront relaxation room

verified_facts.text: The spa's outdoor vitality pool has six hydrotherapy pods and an infinity edge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our one-of-a-kind outdoor vitality pool has six specialized hydrotherapy pods designed to enhance your wellbeing through the therapeutic use of water.

verified_facts.text: The spa's thermal area includes a eucalyptus steam room and a Finnish sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our state-of-the-art wellness spa in Longboat Key includes: Eucalyptus Steam Room, Finnish Sauna, Showers.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a Winding River for leisurely floating.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exquisitely...See More landscaped haven is also home to our Winding River, perfect for a leisurely float

verified_facts.text: CW Prime serves steaks and seafood prepared on a Josper grill.

verified_facts.text: CW Prime won Wine Spectator's 2025 Award of Excellence.
verified_facts.excerpt: CW Prime, winner of Wine Spectator’s 2025 Award of Excellence

verified_facts.text: Oshen is a rooftop lounge serving Nikkei cuisine, combining Japanese flavors and sushi with Peruvian spice.
verified_facts.excerpt: Serving refined flavors of Nikkei, combining Japanese umami-rich flavors and sushi in Longboat Key with the bold Peruvian spice.

verified_facts.text: Aura honors Latin American culture and offers tequila and mezcal tastings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Aura honors Latin American culture through its menus, music, and ambiance. This restaurant near Longboat Key serves irresistible dishes and offers tequila and mezcal tastings.

verified_facts.text: Riva serves Coastal Italian cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: The new Riva menus have arrived, thoughtfully crafted to reflect Coastal Italian cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The Monkey Bar is a beach bar with upscale tiki cocktails and Polynesian flavors.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Monkey Bar exudes Gulf-side glamor while infusing a modern twist into upscale tiki cocktail culture. This Longboat Key beach restaurant serves creative drinks and innovative Polynesian culinary flavors.

verified_facts.excerpt: The St. Regis Longboat Key's social hub features a unique mural by Floridian artist William Savarese.

verified_facts.text: The Katherine Klauber Suite is named for The Colony Beach & Tennis Resort's President and General Manager of 25 years.

verified_facts.text: The Eugenie Clark Ocean View Suite honors marine biologist Eugenie Clark, known as The Shark Lady.
verified_facts.excerpt: This luxury hotel suite in Longboat Key honors Eugenie Clark, The Shark Lady, and her extraordinary contributions to marine biology and conservation.

verified_facts.text: The resort's suites range from one to four bedrooms, with private terraces and views of the Gulf of Mexico.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have marble bathrooms with deep soaking tubs and double vanities.

verified_facts.text: St. Regis Butler Service is available to guests at the resort.
